card.text: Two-lobed Kuiper Belt object that New Horizons flew past.

introduction.text: Arrokoth's two lobes are joined at a narrow neck. New Horizons photographed its southern side up close.

albedo.title: New Horizons LORRI albedo model
albedo.summary: Albedo fitted from 30 approach images. Uniform areas are fill where the images give no constraint.

model.title: Published New Horizons shape
model.summary: The released New Horizons shape: images constrain the south, and the unseen north is estimated.
